notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Whisperer of the Wilds and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
description:
Activate Rex using Whisperer of the Wilds's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
